//: The publishable stdio server, compiled to plain JavaScript.
Separate from the app's tsconfig because what gets published is a different
program: it talks to the hosted API over HTTP and never touches Postgres,
Next or React. TypeScript follows the imports from the entry point, so this
emits exactly the files `mcp/server.ts` can reach and nothing else — which
is the check that keeps the package honest. If a database import ever
reaches the tool surface again, this build is where it shows up.
